questions.stem: Which sentence correctly says the operator discarded the worn bearing?

options.text: Discarded the operator the worn bearing.
The worn bearing discarded the operator.
The operator discarded the worn bearing.
The worn bearing was discarded the operator.

questions.explanation: Agent acts on patient in active order. B swaps roles, C scrambles, and D mixes passive with an active verb.
questions.hint: Keep agent, verb, then patient.

questions.subject: CHINESE
questions.learningObjective: Explain passive emphasis on a worn bearing
questions.stem: Explain why a passive sentence in a brief emphasizes the worn bearing rather than the operator.

answer.exemplar: Passive sentence makes the worn bearing the subject, so attention rests on the component's condition, while the operator is omitted as unimportant.

questions.explanation: Fronting the patient highlights the bearing. The actor is omitted because the brief tracks component condition, not who operated it.
questions.hint: The subject position draws the eye.

questions.subject: CHINESE
questions.learningObjective: Choose neutral viewpoint in a vibration report

stimulus.body: The bracket vibrated during the endurance test. The engineer added a stiffener and retested.

questions.stem: Which wording reports the bracket vibration without assigning blame?

options.text: You forgot the stiffener.
The bracket was obviously defective.
We deliberately omitted the stiffener.
The bracket vibrated; the engineer added a stiffener.

questions.explanation: B reports facts and the corrective action. A blames the reader, C admits intent, and D asserts an unverified defect.
questions.hint: State facts and the corrective action.

questions.subject: CHINESE
questions.learningObjective: Distinguish degree 得 from a particle
questions.stem: Which sentence uses 得 as a degree marker rather than a particle?

options.text: The result is 得 that the bracket passed.
The team 得 approval before testing.
The bracket vibrated 得 slightly during testing.
The bracket vibrated 得 fast under load.
options.misconception: labels a speed extent as particle

questions.explanation: A uses 得 as a degree marker after the verb. B involves obtaining, C a complement clause, and D an extent mislabeled as particle.
questions.hint: Degree marker follows the verb and precedes extent.
